messages:
maya: Quick help please 0: manager in platform has 2 promo requests: IC->Sr IC (US) and Sr IC->Staff (US). They want retro to 12/01. What's the absolute minimum to get payroll & HRIS to process retro for December?

elaine: Minimum checklist: 1) evidence packet (3 bullets) 2) comp_changes spreadsheet with final numbers 3) Greenhouse change record + tag #hris-pickup. Deadline for payroll cycle: comp sheet in by 11/15.

maya: Do we need VP email sign-off if moving band for Staff?

elaine: Yes for band moves. Slack verbal ok, but we need a written approval in the packet (email or GH comment).

tom: If manager wants only base retro (no equity/bonus), note that equity can't be retro'd. Finance prefers base + prorated bonus only.

hris-bot: Automation note: Use filename pattern comp_changes/<LAST>-<YYYYMMDD>-promo-<CUR>.xlsx. Missing currency column = manual delay.

maya: Thanks. I'll collect evidence and upload by 11/10 then create GH change and tag. If anything misses, we'll default to 01/01 effective.

elaine: Also check benefits threshold if base crosses a band that affects health plan tiers. Add benefits note in packet if applicable.

maya: Perfect, pinging manager now :thumbsup:
